title: Keep excerpts in the text's order
statement: List excerpts from a text in the order they occur in it, since a reordered list can make a line seem to belong to the wrong speaker or moment.
example: A story-order check found three tap lists out of order across three lessons.
detail: An outside quick-check audit of four reading lessons rated high a tap list that was out of story order: the keyed line sat after a non-evidence line from another character, so it read as the wrong speaker (`grade3-reading/artifacts/feedback-inceptbench-2026-09-30/REGISTER.md`, L6-H4). The project encoded the class as a story-order check in its passage-reference validator, which found three such lists across three lessons, and a tool reordered them (`grade3-reading/artifacts/feedback-inceptbench-2026-09-30/BUILD-SPEC-batch.md`).
